text_block_list.text:
Just before the Satsuki Sho, Марузенски
tells me
that running has lost all of its
joy for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I take the melancholy Марузенски to
watch the
younger students as they train
hard, trying to
catch up to their role
model.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик and Грасс Вандер happily
train
late into the evening, dreaming of
someday
catching up to Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing them, Марузенски realizes that
her
running has the power to inspire
people and bring
them joy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To set an example for the other
students,
Марузенски becomes
determined to run her heart
out at the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
